research_delta.new_finding: The D/E labeler blocker is no longer purely absent at source level, but training remains blocked until the labeler is bound into a transition-aware semantic-Hyperposition admission path. A synthetic deterministic task-world result must never be encoded as causal RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE merely to pass a generic TrainingTrace gate.
research_delta.architecture_feedback: Use two explicitly typed layers: semantic_hyperposition.task_resolution for synthetic/task-local cognitive state, and causal evidence-level hyperposition/resolution only for admitted measured/verified evidence. This preserves GRF epistemic typing and prevents training the model to confuse generated proof worlds with durable facts.
research_delta.counterhypothesis: A single unified resolved state could simplify training and still be harmless because canonical_truth_allowed=false is present.
research_delta.counterhypothesis_rejected_reason: The model is being trained on epistemic type behavior itself; collapsing synthetic task resolution into a field named RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE creates a learnable type error even if runtime authority bits remain false. Structural type separation is therefore part of the target capability, not only a runtime safety fence.
research_delta.falsifier: A successor representation may unify storage only if model-visible/evaluator-visible typing still deterministically distinguishes synthetic/task-local resolution from admitted causal evidence and all epistemic confusion/authority gates remain zero on frozen holdouts.
